title: Yoshi's Island
notes: Managed-content package bound by SHA-256 to one operator-supplied SNES cartridge dump held in the console-managed object store; this repository ships no ROM and no emulator binary.
No controller, audio, video, save, or timing evidence exists for this title on any target, so the compatibility status stays unverified even though the frontend and core artifact hashes are recorded.

LicenseRef-Snes9x-Noncommercial: Snes9x grants use, copy, modification, and distribution in source and binary form for non-commercial purposes only, is freeware for personal use only, and the libretro port states commercial rights will never be given (D-186). This package may therefore never declare rights.distribution as redistributable.

Snes9x component attribution: JMA under GPL and LGPL, snes_ntsc under LGPL, and xBRZ under GPL-3.0. Super Nintendo Entertainment System, Yoshi, and Super Mario World are trademarks of Nintendo, which does not endorse this project.

The frontend and core hashes record one native aarch64 build observation on a Raspberry Pi 5. Neither artifact was signed, scanned, or built from a pinned toolchain, so they are not reproducible-build evidence.
No licence covers the content; the operator supplies a dump of a cartridge they hold and the console never redistributes it.
